create_blockwise_sparsifier: create a BlockwiseMagnitudeSparsifier instance with sparsity, block_size, and columnwise_blocking config
get_sparsifiable_params: get all 2D trainable parameters from a PyTorch model for blockwise sparsification
get_current_sparsity: get the current sparsity ratio of a model's 2D trainable parameters
compute_param_mask: compute a blockwise magnitude-based pruning mask for a 2D tensor parameter
get_masks: get sparsification masks for all 2D trainable parameters in a PyTorch model
